entry.title: Migration to Zola
entry.content:
My BlueHost subscription was about to expire, and one of my new year resolutions is to reduce the number of subscriptions I'm paying for. So I've decided to move to a static website, and I've picked Zola a bit randomly. Mainly because it's written in Rust and I didn't want to bother with Python or Ruby for a project like this.

I've used Claude Code to quickly clean up the Markdown of my 20 years of posts, and after a bit of work, I've got this new website.

Everything is currently hosted on GitHub Pages, but I'm also reconsidering reducing my dependency on GitHub. This may be a good resolution for 2027 :-).

I also want to use Mastodon and BlueSky for the comments now. I've manually created a new entry there for BSky and one for Mastodon, I will take a look later to see how this can be automated.
